candidates.name: AI Contract Scanner for Freelancers
candidates.concept: Mobile AI app that scans contracts (PDF/photo/camera), flags risky clauses in plain language, and suggests negotiation points. On-device processing for privacy.

candidates.solution: AI-powered clause risk detector with plain-English explanations, risk score (0-100), and specific negotiation suggestions per clause type.
differentiation: gig-economy-specific clause templates (platform terms, NDA, SOW)
